ROOT.proceduredef: CREATE Procedure CDN.MobS_EksportRej @CentrumID INT, -- ID centrum praw struktury firmy @OpeNumer INT, -- ID mobilnego sprzedawcy @TypEksportu INT -- Typ eksportu (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) AS BEGIN SELECT REJ_Id, REJ_OjciecId, REJ_Nazwa, REJ_Opis FROM CDN.Rejony JOIN CDN.KntOpiekun ON KtO_KntNumer=REJ_Id JOIN CDN.OpeKarty ON Ope_PrcNumer=KtO_PrcNumer WHERE KtO_KntTyp=948 AND Ope_GIDNumer=@OpeNumer END

CREATE Procedure CDN.MobS_EksportPSp @CentrumID INT, -- ID centrum praw struktury firmy @OpeNumer INT, -- ID mobilnego sprzedawcy @TypEksportu INT -- Typ eksportu (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) AS BEGIN DECLARE @Dzis INT DECLARE @TimeStamp INT DECLARE @Typ_GrK SMALLINT DECLARE @KnGTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @TwGTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @KnGNumer INT DECLARE @TwGNumer INT DECLARE @Rejony TABLE (KtOTyp SMALLINT, KtONumer INT)
SET @Typ_GrK = -32 SELECT @Dzis = DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(datetime,'18001228',112),CONVERT(datetime,GetDate(),112)) SELECT @KnGTyp=PcK_KnGETyp, @KnGNumer=PcK_KnGENumer, @TwGTyp=PcK_TwGTyp, @TwGNumer=PcK_TwGNumer, @TimeStamp=PcK_TSSynchrPtw FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4
INSERT INTO @Rejony SELECT KtO_KntTyp, KtO_KntNumer FROM CDN.OpeKarty JOIN CDN.KntOpiekun ON Ope_PrcNumer=KtO_PrcNumer WHERE Ope_GIDNumer=@OpeNumer AND (KtO_KntTyp=948 OR (KtO_KntTyp=32 AND @Dzis BETWEEN KtO_DataOd AND KtO_DataDo));
SELECT DISTINCT PSp_ID, PSp_Nazwa, CDN.TSToDate(PSp_DataOd,0) AS PSp_DataOd, CDN.TSToDate(PSp_DataDo,0) AS PSp_DataDo, PSp_Typ, CDN.TSToDate(PSp_DataUtworzenia,0) AS PSp_DataUtworzenia, PSp_Stan, PSp_Opis, 1 As PSp_Aktywny INTO #TempTable FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazy LEFT JOIN CDN.PlanSprzedazyRej ON PSp_ID=PSR_PSpID WHERE PSp_Stan <> 1 AND PSp_CzasModyfikacji >= CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN 0 ELSE 0 END AND (PSR_RejID IS NULL OR PSR_RejID IN (SELECT KtONumer FROM @Rejony WHERE KtOTyp=948) )
--AND PSR_RejID IN (SELECT KtONumer FROM @Rejony WHERE KtOTyp=948) SELECT * FROM #TempTable
IF @KnGTyp = @Typ_GrK BEGIN -- Grupy nadrzędne SELECT PSK_PSpID, PSK_KntTyp, PSK_KntNumer FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyKnt JOIN #TempTable ON PSp_ID=PSK_PSpID JOIN CDN.KntLinki ON KnL_GIDTyp=PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GIDNumer=PSK_KntNumer WHERE KnL_GrOTyp=@KnGTyp AND KnL_GrONumer=@KnGNumer UNION ALL -- Grupa SELECT PSK_PSpID, PSK_KntTyp, PSK_KntNumer FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyKnt JOIN #TempTable ON PSp_ID=PSK_PSpID WHERE PSK_KntTyp=@KnGTyp AND PSK_KntNumer=@KnGNumer UNION ALL -- Grupy i kontrahenci podrzędni SELECT PSK_PSpID, PSK_KntTyp, PSK_KntNumer FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyKnt JOIN #TempTable ON PSp_ID=PSK_PSpID JOIN CDN.KntLinki ON KnL_GrOTyp=PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GrONumer=PSK_KntNumer WHERE KnL_GIDTyp=@KnGTyp AND KnL_GIDNumer=@KnGNumer END ELSE BEGIN -- Grupy SELECT PSK_PSpID, PSK_KntTyp, PSK_KntNumer FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyKnt JOIN #TempTable ON PSp_ID=PSK_PSpID WHERE PSK_KntTyp=@Typ_GrK UNION ALL -- Kontrahenci opiekuna SELECT PSK_PSpID, PSK_KntTyp, PSK_KntNumer FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyKnt JOIN #TempTable ON PSp_ID=PSK_PSpID JOIN CDN.KntKarty ON Knt_GIDTyp=PSK_KntTyp AND Knt_GIDNumer=PSK_KntNumer WHERE Knt_RegionCRM IN (SELECT KtONumer FROM @Rejony WHERE KtOTyp=948) END
-- Grupy nadrzędne SELECT PST_PSpID, PST_TwrTyp, PST_TwrNumer FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyTwr JOIN #TempTable ON PSp_ID=PST_PSpID JOIN CDN.TwrLinki ON TwL_GIDTyp=PST_TwrTyp AND TwL_GIDNumer=PST_TwrNumer WHERE TwL_GrOTyp=@TwGTyp AND TwL_GrONumer=@TwGNumer UNION ALL -- Grupa SELECT PST_PSpID, PST_TwrTyp, PST_TwrNumer FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyTwr JOIN #TempTable ON PSp_ID=PST_PSpID WHERE PST_TwrTyp=@TwGTyp AND PST_TwrNumer=@TwGNumer UNION ALL -- Grupy i towary podrzędne SELECT PST_PSpID, PST_TwrTyp, PST_TwrNumer FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyTwr JOIN #TempTable ON PSp_ID=PST_PSpID JOIN CDN.TwrLinki ON TwL_GrOTyp=PST_TwrTyp AND TwL_GrONumer=PST_TwrNumer WHERE TwL_GIDTyp=@TwGTyp AND TwL_GIDNumer=@TwGNumer
SELECT PSR_PSpID, PSR_RejID, PSp_Typ AS PSR_Typ, PSR_Wartosc, 0 AS PSR_WartoscSpr, 0 AS PSR_WartoscZam FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyRej JOIN #TempTable ON PSp_ID=PSR_PSpID WHERE PSR_RejID IN (SELECT KtONumer FROM @Rejony WHERE KtOTyp=948)
DROP TABLE #TempTable; END

CREATE Procedure CDN.MobS_EksportPSpReal @CentrumID INT, -- ID centrum praw struktury firmy @OpeNumer INT, -- ID mobilnego sprzedawcy @TypEksportu INT -- Typ eksportu (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) AS BEGIN DECLARE @Today DATETIME SET @Today = GETDATE()
DECLARE @Rejony TABLE (KtOTyp SMALLINT, KtONumer INT) CREATE TABLE #RejonyLinki (RejonID INT,RejOjciecID INT) INSERT INTO #RejonyLinki SELECT * FROM CDN.RejonyLinki()
INSERT INTO @Rejony SELECT KtO_KntTyp, KtO_KntNumer FROM CDN.KntOpiekun INNER JOIN CDN.OpeKarty ON Ope_PrcNumer=KtO_PrcNumer WHERE Ope_GIDNumer=@OpeNumer AND KtO_KntTyp=948;
DECLARE @WalutaSystemowa VARCHAR(4) DECLARE @TSTamp INT
SELECT @WalutaSystemowa = Kon_Wartosc FROM CDN.Konfig WHERE Kon_Numer = 211 SET @TSTamp = DATEDIFF(s,'19900101',GETDATE());
DECLARE @PSP_DoWyslania TABLE (PSP_Id int ,PSp_Typ int, PsR_Wartosc DECIMAL(18,2),PSR_RejID INT , PSp_DataOd int,PSp_DataDo int)
----------------------------------PSP DO WYSLANIA-------------------------------------------- INSERT INTO @PSP_DoWyslania SELECT PsP_Id, PsP_Typ, PsR_Wartosc, PSR_RejID, PSp_DataOd, PSp_DataDo FROM (SELECT PsP_Id, PSp_Typ, PSR_Wartosc, PSR_RejID, PSp_DataOd, PSp_DataDo FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazy INNER JOIN CDN.PlanSprzedazyKnt (NOLOCK) ON PSK_PSPID = PSp_ID INNER JOIN CDN.KntLinki (NOLOCK) ON (KnL_GroTyp = PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GroNumer = PSK_KntNumer AND PSK_KntTyp = -32) OR (KnL_GIDTyp = PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GIDNumer = PSK_KntNumer AND PSK_KntTyp = 32) INNER JOIN CDN.KntKarty (NOLOCK) ON Knt_GIDNumer = KnL_GIDNumer INNER JOIN CDN.PlanSprzedazyRej (NOLOCK) ON PSR_PSPID = PSp_ID INNER JOIN #RejonyLinki ON RejOjciecID = PSR_RejID AND RejonID = Knt_RegionCRM INNER JOIN @Rejony ON RejonID = KtONumer GROUP BY PsP_Id,PSp_Typ, PSR_RejID,PSp_DataOd,PSp_DataDo, PSR_Wartosc ) AS PlanySpr ;
-------------------------------WYNIK KONCOWY -------------------------------------------------
WITH PSPReal_Wyn2 AS( SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(ZaE_Ilosc),0) as DECIMAL(21,4)) as Ilosc,0 as ZamFak /*zam*/,RejonID,PspId FROM ( SELECT ZaE_Ilosc,RejonID, DW.PSP_ID as PspId FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyKnt (NOLOCK) JOIN @PSP_DoWyslania DW ON DW.PSP_ID = PSK_PSpID and DW.PSP_Typ = 2 JOIN CDN.KntLinki (NOLOCK) ON (KnL_GroTyp = PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GroNumer = PSK_KntNumer AND PSK_KntTyp = -32) OR (KnL_GIDTyp = PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GIDNumer = PSK_KntNumer AND PSK_KntTyp = 32) JOIN CDN.KntKarty (NOLOCK) ON Knt_GIDNumer = KnL_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.PlanSprzedazyTwr (NOLOCK) ON PST_PSPID = DW.PSP_ID JOIN CDN.TwrLinki (NOLOCK) ON (TwL_GroTyp = PST_TwrTyp AND TwL_GroNumer = PST_TwrNumer AND PST_TwrTyp = -16) OR (TwL_GIDTyp = PST_TwrTyp AND TwL_GIDNumer = PST_TwrNumer AND PST_TwrTyp = 16) CROSS APPLY CDN.PlanySprzedazyRejonyPodrz(DW.PSP_ID) JOIN CDN.ZamNag (NOLOCK) ON ZaN_KntNumer = KnL_GIDNumer AND ZaN_DataWystawienia BETWEEN DW.PSp_DataOd AND DW.PSp_DataDo AND ZaN_Stan&32 <> 32 AND ZaN_ZamTyp&1024 = 1024 JOIN CDN.ZamElem (NOLOCK) ON ZaE_GIDNumer = ZaN_GIDNumer AND ZaE_TwrNumer = TwL_GIDNumer WHERE RejonID = Knt_RegionCRM AND RejonID = DW.PSR_RejID --PSK_PSpID = @PSPID GROUP BY KnL_GIDNumer,TwL_GIDNumer,RejonID,ZaE_GIDNumer,ZaE_GIDLp,ZaE_Ilosc,DW.PSP_ID ) WYN GROUP BY RejonID,PspId
union all
SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(TrE_Ilosc),0) as DECIMAL(21,4)) as Ilosc,1 as ZamFak /*fak*/,RejonID,PspId FROM ( SELECT TrE_Ilosc,RejonID, DW.PSP_ID as PspId FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyKnt (NOLOCK) JOIN @PSP_DoWyslania DW ON DW.PSP_ID = PSK_PSpID and DW.PSP_Typ = 2 JOIN CDN.KntLinki (NOLOCK) ON (KnL_GroTyp = PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GroNumer = PSK_KntNumer AND PSK_KntTyp = -32) OR (KnL_GIDTyp = PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GIDNumer = PSK_KntNumer AND PSK_KntTyp = 32) JOIN CDN.KntKarty (NOLOCK) ON Knt_GIDNumer = KnL_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.PlanSprzedazyTwr (NOLOCK) ON PST_PSPID = DW.PSP_ID JOIN CDN.TwrLinki (NOLOCK) ON (TwL_GroTyp = PST_TwrTyp AND TwL_GroNumer = PST_TwrNumer AND PST_TwrTyp = -16) OR (TwL_GIDTyp = PST_TwrTyp AND TwL_GIDNumer = PST_TwrNumer AND PST_TwrTyp = 16) CROSS APPLY CDN.PlanySprzedazyRejonyPodrz(DW.PSP_ID) --ON RejonID = Knt_RegionCRM JOIN CDN.TraNag (NOLOCK) ON TrN_KntNumer = KnL_GIDNumer AND TrN_Data2 BETWEEN DW.PSp_DataOd AND DW.PSp_DataDo AND TrN_Stan <> 6 AND TrN_GIDTyp IN (2033,2035,2037,2001,2005,2034) JOIN CDN.TraElem (NOLOCK) ON TrE_GIDNumer = TrN_GIDNumer AND TrE_TwrNumer = TwL_GIDNumer WHERE RejonID = Knt_RegionCRM AND RejonID = DW.PSR_RejID --WHERE PSK_PSpID = @PSPID GROUP BY KnL_GIDNumer,TwL_GIDNumer,RejonID,TrE_GIDNumer,TrE_GIDLp,TrE_Ilosc,DW.PSP_ID ) WYN GROUP BY RejonID,PspId
union all
SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(ROUND((CASE WHEN ZaE_Waluta <> @WalutaSystemowa THEN CASE WHEN ZaN_TypKursu = 1 THEN CDN.WartoscWWalucieSys(ZaE_WartoscPoRabacie,ZaE_Waluta,ZaE_NrKursu,@TSTamp) WHEN ZaN_TypKursu = 2 THEN ZaE_WartoscPoRabacie*(ZaV_KursL/ZaV_KursM) WHEN ZaN_TypKursu = 3 AND ZaN_DataWaznosci<=DATEDIFF(d,CONVERT(DATETIME,'1800-12-28',120),@Today) THEN CDN.WartoscWWalucieSys(ZaE_WartoscPoRabacie,ZaE_Waluta,ZaE_NrKursu,@TSTamp) ELSE ZaE_WartoscPoRabacie*(ZaV_KursL/ZaV_KursM) END ELSE ZaE_WartoscPoRabacie END) /(CASE WHEN ZaN_FlagaNB='N' THEN 1 ELSE 1+(ZaE_StawkaPod*0.01) END),2)),0)as DECIMAL(21,4)) ,0 as ZamFak,RejonID, PspId FROM ( SELECT ZaE_Waluta,ZaN_TypKursu,ZaN_DataWaznosci,ZaE_WartoscPoRabacie,ZaE_NrKursu,ZaV_KursL,ZaV_KursM,RejonID,ZaN_FlagaNB,ZaE_StawkaPod, DW.PSP_ID as PspId FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyKnt (NOLOCK) JOIN @PSP_DoWyslania DW ON DW.PSP_ID = PSK_PSpID and DW.PSP_Typ = 1 JOIN CDN.KntLinki (NOLOCK) ON (KnL_GroTyp = PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GroNumer = PSK_KntNumer AND PSK_KntTyp = -32) OR (KnL_GIDTyp = PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GIDNumer = PSK_KntNumer AND PSK_KntTyp = 32) JOIN CDN.KntKarty (NOLOCK) ON Knt_GIDNumer = KnL_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.PlanSprzedazyTwr (NOLOCK) ON PST_PSPID = DW.PSP_ID JOIN CDN.TwrLinki (NOLOCK) ON (TwL_GroTyp = PST_TwrTyp AND TwL_GroNumer = PST_TwrNumer AND PST_TwrTyp = -16) OR (TwL_GIDTyp = PST_TwrTyp AND TwL_GIDNumer = PST_TwrNumer AND PST_TwrTyp = 16) CROSS APPLY CDN.PlanySprzedazyRejonyPodrz(DW.PSP_ID) --ON RejonID = Knt_RegionCRM JOIN CDN.ZamNag (NOLOCK) ON ZaN_KntNumer = KnL_GIDNumer AND ZaN_DataWystawienia BETWEEN DW.PSp_DataOd AND DW.PSp_DataDo AND ZaN_Stan&32 <> 32 AND ZaN_ZamTyp&1024 = 1024 JOIN CDN.ZamElem (NOLOCK) ON ZaE_GIDNumer = ZaN_GIDNumer AND ZaE_TwrNumer = TwL_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.ZamVat (NOLOCK) ON ZaV_GIDNumer = ZaE_GIDNumer WHERE RejonID = Knt_RegionCRM AND RejonID = DW.PSR_RejID --WHERE PSK_PSpID = @PSPID GROUP BY KnL_GIDNumer,TwL_GIDNumer,RejonID,ZaE_GIDNumer,ZaE_GIDLp,ZaE_Ilosc,ZaE_Waluta, ZaN_TypKursu,ZaN_DataWaznosci,ZaE_WartoscPoRabacie,ZaE_NrKursu, ZaV_KursL,ZaV_KursM,ZaN_FlagaNB,ZaE_StawkaPod,DW.PSP_ID ) WYN GROUP BY RejonID,PspId
union all
SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(TrE_KsiegowaNetto),0)as DECIMAL(21,4)), 1 as ZamFak,RejonID, PspId FROM ( SELECT TrE_KsiegowaNetto,RejonID, DW.PSP_ID as PspId FROM CDN.PlanSprzedazyKnt (NOLOCK) JOIN @PSP_DoWyslania DW ON DW.PSP_ID = PSK_PSpID and DW.PSP_Typ = 1 JOIN CDN.KntLinki (NOLOCK) ON (KnL_GroTyp = PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GroNumer = PSK_KntNumer AND PSK_KntTyp = -32) OR (KnL_GIDTyp = PSK_KntTyp AND KnL_GIDNumer = PSK_KntNumer AND PSK_KntTyp = 32) JOIN CDN.KntKarty (NOLOCK) ON Knt_GIDNumer = KnL_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.PlanSprzedazyTwr (NOLOCK) ON PST_PSPID = DW.PSP_ID JOIN CDN.TwrLinki (NOLOCK) ON (TwL_GroTyp = PST_TwrTyp AND TwL_GroNumer = PST_TwrNumer AND PST_TwrTyp = -16) OR (TwL_GIDTyp = PST_TwrTyp AND TwL_GIDNumer = PST_TwrNumer AND PST_TwrTyp = 16) CROSS APPLY CDN.PlanySprzedazyRejonyPodrz(DW.PSP_ID) --ON RejonID = Knt_RegionCRM JOIN CDN.TraNag (NOLOCK) ON TrN_KntNumer = KnL_GIDNumer AND TrN_Data2 BETWEEN DW.PSp_DataOd AND DW.PSp_DataDo AND TrN_Stan <> 6 AND TrN_GIDTyp IN (2033,2035,2037,2001,2005,2034) JOIN CDN.TraElem (NOLOCK) ON TrE_GIDNumer = TrN_GIDNumer AND TrE_TwrNumer = TwL_GIDNumer WHERE RejonID = Knt_RegionCRM AND RejonID = DW.PSR_RejID GROUP BY KnL_GIDNumer,TwL_GIDNumer,RejonID,TrE_GIDNumer,TrE_GIDLp,TrE_KsiegowaNetto,DW.PSP_ID ) WYN GROUP BY RejonID,PspId
) --end WITH
SELECT TAB1.PsP_Id as PSR_PSpID,TAB1.PSp_Typ as PSR_Typ,COALESCE(PSR_Wartosc,0) AS PSR_Wartosc, TAB1.PSR_RejID as PSR_RejID, ISNULL(TAB2.Ilosc, 0) AS PSR_WartoscZam,ISNULL(Tab3.Ilosc, 0) AS PSR_WartoscSpr FROM @PSP_DoWyslania TAB1 left join PSPReal_Wyn2 TAB2 ON TAB2.RejonID = TAB1.PSR_RejID AND TAB2.PspId = TAB1.PSP_Id AND TAB2.ZamFak = 0 left join PSPReal_Wyn2 TAB3 ON TAB3.RejonID = TAB1.PSR_RejID AND TAB3.PspId = TAB1.PSP_Id AND TAB3.ZamFak = 1
ORDER BY TAB1.PsP_Id
DROP TABLE #RejonyLinki
END
